item.title: VR Game
item.description: Project Overview Project Goal: To create a deeply immersive VR experience that explores themes of loss, healing, and connection. Through a combination of realistic 3D environments, atmospheric storytelling, and interactive mechanics, the project aims to evoke emotions and engage players in a personal journey of transformation. My Role: 3D Modeler & Unity Developer Collaborators: Jayson Van Tram – Lead Programmer & Developer Man Ying Angela Lee – Visual Designer Built With:
